scripts.set-ip:
node -e "const os=require('os');const ifaces=os.networkInterfaces();let ip='localhost';for(let iface in ifaces){for(let alias of ifaces[iface]){if(alias.family==='IPv4'&&!alias.internal){ip=alias.address;break;}}}console.log('# Backend Environment Variables (for local development)
# This file is for local development only NOT committed to git

MY_IP='+ip+'

FE_URL=http://'+ip+':4200

REACT_APP_BE_URL=http://'+ip+':3333/');" > .env.local
